_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'REQUIREMENTS DOCUMENTATION' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.02.03.

f01_Business_Objectives_and_Goals.label: Business Objectives and Goals
f01_Business_Objectives_and_Goals.guidance: High-level organizational motivations, strategic drivers, and target business problems to solve.

f02_Business_Process_Impact.label: Business Process Impact
f02_Business_Process_Impact.guidance: Current-state vs. target-state operational workflow enhancements and process impacts.

f03_Business_Value_and_Success_Criteria.label: Business Value and Success Criteria
f03_Business_Value_and_Success_Criteria.guidance: Measurable commercial, operational, or customer value expected upon delivery.

f04_User_Persona_and_Needs_Summary.label: User Persona and Needs Summary
f04_User_Persona_and_Needs_Summary.guidance: Detailed operational requirements categorized by specific stakeholder groups and user personas.

f05_Stakeholder_Pain_Points_and_Expectat.label: Stakeholder Pain Points and Expectations
f05_Stakeholder_Pain_Points_and_Expectat.guidance: Critical operational pain points addressed and expected behavioral outcomes.

f06_Functional_Requirements_Specificatio.label: Functional Requirements Specification
f06_Functional_Requirements_Specificatio.guidance: Detailed capabilities, system interactions, features, and functional behavior.

f07_Technical_Architecture_and_System_Co.label: Technical Architecture and System Constraints
f07_Technical_Architecture_and_System_Co.guidance: System interfaces, infrastructure prerequisites, data architecture, and technological boundaries.

f08_Non_Functional_Requirements_Quality_.label: Non-Functional Requirements (Quality of Service)
f08_Non_Functional_Requirements_Quality_.guidance: Performance thresholds, security standards, availability, scalability, and usability criteria.

f09_Transition_and_Readiness_Requirement.label: Transition and Readiness Requirements
f09_Transition_and_Readiness_Requirement.guidance: Data migration, end-user training, operational handover, and rollout support prerequisites.
